quantization: bitsandbytes 0.50.2 NF4, double quantization, BF16 computation; large unquantized experts cause a failure, not a silent precision change.
runtime: Torch 2.11.0+cu128; Transformers 5.17.0, except isolated 4.57.1 for the upstream Spark custom architecture.
spark_compatibility: Pinned upstream custom source; two activation casts changed from stored weight dtype to quantized layer compute dtype. Both source hashes recorded in model manifest.
retrieval: SCOPE + Hybrid RRF + Rerank + Jiwar, abbreviation and BM25 synonym expansion, only AASM and ICSD-3-TR. Frozen identical context across models.
context: 4096 reference Gemma4 tokenizer tokens, at most 8 blocks. Audit with every answer tokenizer; no silent truncation.
order: One case per source book first, remaining dataset order; alternate condition order by case index.
timing: Single-request GPU-synchronized generation; excludes cached retrieval and model loading. Hardware differs between models; report GPU for latency comparisons.
description: Scientific settings for the published thesis cohort; operational scheduling is omitted.
